about_page.title: Who We Are
about_page.story: The digital universe of the UM Pilates & Yoga experience: The Yumiverse is a luxury wellness sanctuary founded to help you leave modern stresses behind and reconnect with your mind and body. Inspired by the unique nature of Iskenderun and Arsuz, our studio offers a personalized, premium experience with a sleek Scandinavian design, a calm atmosphere, and a highly professional training staff.
about_page.mission_text: To empower you to discover your body's strength, improve your quality of movement, and cultivate mental stillness as a daily practice.
about_page.vision_text: By combining wellness philosophy with an elegant and premium feel, we aim to build the most prestigious yoga and reformer pilates community in the region.
